stem_book: A toy cyclist completes one round of a square track of side 2 m in 40 seconds. What will be the displacement at the end of 3 minutes? (a) 52 m (b) Zero (c) 16 m (d) 2√2 m
reason: Manifest option (a) read '52' without unit; print is 52 m.
work: 180 s / 40 s = 4.5 rounds ⇒ ends at the corner diagonally opposite the start ⇒ displacement = √(2² + 2²) = 2√2 m
